subject: being alone
caption: You can be alone and not lonely, or surrounded and completely lonely. Which one is yours lately?

beats.text: Being alone feels different for four kinds of people. And only one of them is actually lonely.
Alone is where you become useful again.
You put something on, anything, so the room isn't quiet.
You keep busy so you never have to find out how you actually feel.
You're alone and fine, until you remember who used to be there.
Loneliness isn't the absence of people. It's the absence of being known.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
